implementation: Offline bounded reference preview/plan/apply/cancel CLI, one exclusive instance lock and installed-head preflight; no implicit database upgrade, runtime, model, native secret or device calls.

Shared offline_plans infrastructure owns non-overwriting private plan publication, bounded JSON, consistent snapshot, complete snapshot validation, immutable backup binding, per-target short transactions, resumption and cancellation for both body and reference maintenance.

Only exact action_objects rows belonging to committed body targets in complete body-pruning batches are eligible. Recheck agent/run/action/reference/object identities, revision, SHA256, byte size, source/context, approvals, fees, work/outbound, leases, pins and pending ownership before every release.
Single transaction deletes the exact agent/action/object/reference edge, advances durable progress and writes audit. All other object references, metadata, expiry, pins and files remain unchanged.

Immutable historical object IDs, SHA and sizes deliberately have no foreign keys to live objects/action_objects. Shared message/document/active-action owners still protect GC. Completed targets resume after a separate physical GC without requiring the live object row.

Repository and SQL triggers reject new or changed artifact references on pruned actions. Partial cancellation retains committed releases and audit, cancels pending only, preserves remaining real references, and allows a fresh reviewed plan.

Real process exits before target commit and before batch completion demonstrate rollback and idempotent resumption. Three v13 DDL interruption phases retain v12 schema and identity, then upgrade cleanly. Exact reflected nullable checks exposed and fixed a missing explicit NOT NULL in new DDL.

Pre-reference-release snapshot restores reference edges and objects into a fresh home, with bodies still pruned. Restoring body content requires the earlier separate pre-body-prune snapshot. Doctor reports unresolved reference batches without leaking protected paths or content.

full.worker_restart: disabled; recorder changes no selection, timeouts, assertions or outcomes

development_failures.reason: New fixture assumed accept_turn message_id and remember manual_reason; corrected to real repository contracts.
Late-source fixture attempted editing immutable existing provenance. Changed fixture to insert a new valid source edge; preserved immutability.
New test parameter IDs exceeded Windows environment limit, and reader accepted non-object JSON before callback. Bounded reader now requires an object; parameter IDs are explicit short labels.
New nullable reflection test exposed missing explicit NOT NULL on the v13 batch primary key. Fixed DDL without relaxing checks.

pending: 180d run-summary/audit retention requires protected manual-source/document-author references and durable cursor watermarks; no audit TTL deletion implemented.
Partially committed then cancelled body batches keep artifact references; this version conservatively accepts complete source batches only.
R4/R5/R6 actual provider/channel/vector business migration and native terminal/desktop/service integration remain incomplete.
macOS/Linux runtime and three-platform model/account/device/load/fault/72h acceptance remain pending; default V1 remains.
